27	- **EVAL-04** Whether the learned agent beats each baseline is tested with the `null-hypothesis-testing` skill. It is given: the hypothesis "the trained agent scores better than the baseline"; H0 = the learned agent's mean score is no better than the baseline's, H1 = it is better (in the world's score direction); the statistic = difference in mean episode score, learned (averaged over the runs, per seed) minus baseline; the null built by randomly swapping the learned and baseline labels within each held-out seed (paired permutation, 10,000 permutations); α = 0.05 with Holm correction across all baseline comparisons in that world (2 per variant); the EVAL-03 held-out episodes.
